name: Gide Guard
headline: Protect yourself from scams, fraud, and suspicious messages.
lede: Quickly review emails, text messages, links, websites, social media messages, and other communications before you respond.

features.title: Scam Detection
features.body: Paste suspicious messages and receive an easy-to-understand risk assessment.

features.title: Email & Text Analysis
features.body: Check emails, text messages, and direct messages for common scam tactics, phishing attempts, and red flags.

features.title: Website Safety Checks
features.body: Review suspicious links and websites before you visit or respond.

features.title: Risk Explanations

features.title: Scam Awareness

features.title: Simple One-Time Purchase

faq.a: Yes. Gide – Guard is available on the App Store as a simple tool to help users recognize suspicious messages and scam warning signs.

faq.q: What types of scams can Guard help identify?
faq.a: Guard is designed to help identify phishing emails, fraudulent text messages, fake websites, impersonation scams, online marketplace scams, suspicious links, and other risky communications.

faq.q: Does Guard guarantee that a message is safe?
faq.a: No. Gide – Guard provides guidance and risk awareness to help you make a more informed decision. No app can guarantee that every message, website, person, or offer is safe.

faq.q: Does Guard replace professional cybersecurity help?
faq.a: No. Gide – Guard is an educational and personal-use tool. It is not a substitute for professional cybersecurity, legal, financial, or fraud investigation services.

faq.q: How much does Gide – Guard cost?
faq.a: Gide – Guard is available for a one-time purchase of $0.99. Buy it once and use it for life. No subscription is required.

cta.heading: Check before you click, reply, or share.
